svg.title: Babul walks an unnumbered market address while Riju records landmarks and witnesses.
svg.desc: Babul pushes his loaded blue cycle van through the closing market and indicates a branching lane. Riju writes down physical landmarks and witnesses instead of inventing a parcel number.
svg.text: Page 22, panel 3 · Tracking wide shot along the market's bent spine

text.tspan: Babul walks an address that no parcel map can
resolve while Riju records witnesses and physical
